name: Mexico City
living: the colourful papel picado banners flutter gently in the breeze (a slow per-row wave)
the golden Angel on top of the column catches a slow moving glint of sunset light
a thin wisp of smoke rises and drifts from the hazy volcano on the horizon
purple jacaranda trees drop a few slow drifting petals
city tower windows flicker on as the sun goes down
magenta and orange pixel clouds drift slowly across the sky
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly, dust motes drifting through the cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
